title: Configurational Taxonomy of Planetary Bodies: A Fuzzy-Set QCA of Orbital Hierarchy, Dynamical Dominance, Composition, and Evolution
domain: planetary science / comparative methods / set-theoretic analysis / taxonomy
summary: A falsification-first configurational taxonomy of 50 Solar-System bodies. Blinded evidence coding now covers all 34 planet/dwarf/satellite cases at least at the composition layer and 139/300 total evidence-state cells. Missingness semantics and the first source-conflict adjudication are frozen before calibration or QCA inspection.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C022 froze the sample, raw-variable architecture, evidence protocol and anti-circularity ladder before analysis. Evidence batches 01-03 now cover all selected planets, dwarf planets and satellites. Protocol v0.3 explicitly treats scientific missingness as a valid state, and source-conflict audit v0.1 adjudicates the Mimas ocean update as temporal supersession. The 16 small/boundary cases remain gated by live SBDB acquisition. No QCA calibration or solution inspection has occurred.

tables.status: case frame + physical + orbit + derived + evidence v0.4
